hypothesis: Request253 shows that waiting for a pullback materially improves entry economics, but no fixed drawdown threshold is positive. A causal recurrent ENTER/WAIT controller using candidate quality plus the observed post-HOT path should learn when to enter, when to keep waiting, and when to abstain.
candidate_threshold_source: 95th percentile of candidate probability on controller-train days only
state_features: return from first observed post-HOT event
path range, efficiency, and time since high/low

targets.enter_value: fixed non-hindsight Request249 value if entering at the current observed state
targets.enter_minus_wait_one_state: current enter value minus the fixed value from entering at the immediately next observed state; final-state WAIT is cash=0

policy: At every observed state, ENTER iff predicted enter value > 0 and predicted enter-minus-next-WAIT advantage >= 0. Otherwise WAIT and reconsider at the next state. If the window ends without ENTER, remain in cash.
comparators: precommitted 2% pullback entry from Request253, with no pullback treated as cash
forbidden: choosing the best future entry state
choosing the best future exit horizon
using May11-20 outcomes to fit the controller or candidate threshold
claiming minute aggregate opens are brokerage fills
next_if_pass: Freeze the learned ENTER/WAIT controller and candidate threshold, then audit execution support and only then consider opening June15-19.
next_if_fail: Inspect whether local entry-value/WAIT targets are learnable; if signal exists but economics fail, add multi-step option value, otherwise redesign the post-HOT state representation.
